name: Views Local Tasks
description: Create 2nd level menu tabs (local tasks) with views without writing YAML code.
project_description:
This module adds support for creating menu local tasks with Views pages without writing YAML code.

 Although Drupal core provides a "Link to display" field that can be added to the view's header to add local task links, but that only works if all the pages that should have a local task link are in the same view. With this module, you can add local tasks (with the view's URL) to any page.

 For further clarification about when and how to use this module can be found in the documentation.
